iconset.notes: Intent first: who reads these icons, where, at what size (min legible px), under which treatment; the families and how they are told apart; what the style guide forbids.

panel.notes: Intent first: what physical thing this is (a bezel, a slip, a plate), where it sits, its sizes in use, what shows through or sits inside, which slots the client fills.

template.notes: Intent first: which document this is, which data fills it (name the sim fields), the width in use and how it grows, what is printed (only copy-sheet words) and what is typed or stamped at runtime.

tokens.notes: Intent first: the materials and states the UI has, and why each colour exists.

fonts.notes: Intent first: which roles need a face, why these faces, and the licence verified from the primary source (OFL.txt + METADATA.pb in google/fonts; no Reserved Font Name if you subset).
